s_per_daa.src: 120 s: target_time_per_block of the 2-minute network, a lower bound (rfc-0012-policy-proposal.md); 125-150 is cited, not measured (F1)

reporter_return_permille.src: ADR-0032 amendment 2026-10-10: PALW reporter share 4,900 bps; a self-reporter recovers it, the net loss is 51 % of the collected slash

participation_q.src: NOT measured: the probability that a verifier is present and checks (F8)

verifiers_n.src: NOT measured: how many independent verifiers exist (F8)

model_holders_n.src: NOT measured and NOT guaranteed by the chain (ADR-0177 D7): how many of them hold the registered model; 0 for a closed model

eps_enf.src: 0: no enforcement failure is assumed; NOT measured

collection_rate.src: 1: ledger.rs convict() slashes min(reserved, bond collateral); a bond slashed elsewhere collects less; NOT measured

bond_bili.src: 13,000 BILI: the t12 producer minimum bond (t12-bond-reuse-audit-2026-10-10.md, a code reading, not a fleet observation)

liability_horizon_daa.src: interim: window 50 + post-Final liability 200 = 250 DAA (palw_kernel_route_policy_v1, PalwPanelFreeFenceV1::interim_v1); not a production value

gain.src: interim OPV terms: Final reward 5 + work credit 5 + external bound 10 = 20 BILI (policy, not measured)
